# NFL Daily — 2026-11-07 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Colts have engaged in trade talks for QB Daniel Jones and continue fielding calls on RB Jonathan Taylor as Tuesday's deadline approaches. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50403440/sources-colts-engaged-daniel-jones-trade-talks)
- Ravens RB Derrick Henry says he's frustrated amid trade speculation, but Baltimore isn't expected to deal him before Tuesday's deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400748/sources-ravens-not-expected-trade-star-rb-derrick-henry) — also [CBS Sports]
- Browns benched Deshaun Watson, who cleared concussion protocol but remains questionable, in favor of Shedeur Sanders for Sunday's game at New Orleans. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50409705/browns-qb-deshaun-watson-concussion-protocol)
- WR Brandon Aiyuk met with 49ers officials Friday to discuss a path forward, with no resolution reached and a $13 million financial dispute still unsettled. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/brandon-aiyuk-returns-49ers-offices-13-million-problem-looms/)

## Transactions
- Ravens acquired QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals, swapping Day 3 draft picks; Baltimore has since waived backup QB Austin Reed and restructured DT Nnamdi Madubuike's contract, creating about $8.7M in cap space to fit the move. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-austin-reed-jacoby-brissett-waive-quarterback) — also [BmoreBeatdown]

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson remains on injured reserve with a thumb injury; his return this season depends on recovery and whether Brissett can keep Baltimore in the playoff picture. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Rams OLB Myles Garrett was officially activated from injured reserve and carries no injury designation for Sunday's game against Washington. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2119127502371123687) — also [Schefter]
- Seahawks G Quenton Nelson will have a minor knee procedure to clear out cartilage; the plan is to avoid injured reserve, with a return timeline of a few weeks. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2118830021863215410)
